title: E40-m5' Stage 1 truth-calibration channel screen
parent_route: m4 G2_AND_NOT_G1 -> draft m5-prime feedback-channel design
question: does any frozen composite of the 8 already-visible feedback fields rank truth (raw wasserstein) out-of-sample (select on R, confirm on P)?

zmean_tp.def: mean of within-chain z-scores over the 6 TP channels

rankmean_tp.def: mean of within-chain ranks over the 6 TP channels

statistics.per_chain: Spearman(direction * candidate, truth) over cycles with finite truth; chains with <3 finite pairs excluded and counted
statistics.pooled: arithmetic mean of per-chain rho (gate); Fisher-z reference reported
statistics.perm: within-chain cycle-shuffle, two-sided |mean rho|, seed 20260831 (m4 M1 seed, GS0-exact), 10000 draws
statistics.census: true-rank of candidate-argmax cycle; CT3-style TP delta vs f0_best; leave-one-chain-out rho stability for the winner on P

GS0_M4_REPRODUCED.rule: reproduce m4 rollup M1 pooled_rho_arithmetic and perm_p_two_sided for pooled_tp on both cohorts, |delta| <= 1e-9, rollup sha256 pinned

GS1_SELECTION_AVAILABLE_ON_R.rule: >=1 candidate other than pooled_tp with R perm_p <= 0.05 and directed pooled rho > 0; winner = max directed pooled rho

GS2_WINNER_CONFIRMED_ON_P.rule: winner P directed pooled rho >= 0.4 AND P perm_p <= 0.05

routing_preregistered.GS2_pass: draft m5-double-prime prospective interventional: fresh 12x4 F2 campaign, winner composite surfaced in feedback+prompt, shipping = winner-argmax, m-series gate battery
routing_preregistered.GS1_pass_GS2_fail: draft Stage-2b seed-replica stability-probe design (only remaining truth-anchor without substrate modification; needs new native runs)
routing_preregistered.GS1_fail: same Stage-2b route; strengthens terminal reading if Stage-2b fails

controls.C2_leakage: FORBIDDEN_SUBSTRINGS absent from every redacted_feedback.json read
controls.full_table: all 24 cohort-by-candidate rows reported; no post-hoc candidate additions

custody.input_manifest: sha256 of every file read incl. the m4 rollup
custody.determinism: byte-identical JSON on re-run; only RNG is the frozen-seed shuffle

no_rescue_clause: screen attributes and selects only; every revival requires the prospective m5-double-prime or Stage-2b execution under its own freeze
